items.change: Add one task that files one GitHub issue on this repository for each distinct unexpected failure in a finished harness-eval run, and names in every issue the eval to re-run to prove the fix. Contract: .spec/prds/harness-eval-framework/09-technical-requirements/11-failure-issues.md, use cases 12-uc-iss.md, criteria T-ISS-001 to T-ISS-034, scenarios .spec/scenarios/UC-ISS-*. Scope: (a) a fifth job `issues` in harness-eval.yml, needs grade, skipped on cancel, only for this repository on refs/heads/main, with contents read, actions read and issues write, no environment, no model key, no App token; (b) test/harness/issues/ holding the filer, expected.json with the five exact pairs, byte copies of the change-request issue-body.md and check-issue-body.sh with UPSTREAM.json digests; (c) the recorder writes grade/refusal.json with only its closed reason, uploaded beside recorder.log; (d) finding classes, grouping, identity, the five-per-attempt cap and roll-up, and author-only dedupe exactly as the contract states, reading each cell's own reason as well as every check row; (e) the body holds validated fields and fixed text only, and passes the scan before filing; (f) the receipt artifact harness-eval-issues-<run_id>-<run_attempt> and a summary section; (g) create the harness-eval label once as a recorded setup step, the filer itself never creates a label. Write scope adds exactly one line of the locked FLOW-RUN-02-HAND: the job list at tests/sprint-01/run-02-hand.test.mjs:169 gains `issues`. Nothing else in that flow changes. Gate additions before the First Contact step, which stays last: (1) after a dispatched run, `gh issue list --repo hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect --label harness-eval --state open --json title --jq '.[].title'` prints one line per unexpected reason in that run and no line for cursor or an adapter-pending harness; (2) a second dispatch of the same commit prints the same lines and the receipt lists them unchanged; (3) after a real fix lands, a person copies the commands from a filed issue's `## Prove the fix` and they print its expected lines, and the same commands on the unfixed commit print something else. `requiredness-undeclared` from T14 is the natural first case. New flows go through the publisher with human-flows.json. Report honestly: UC-ISS-01 AC-1 stays DEFERRED until a real graded failure exists, because no run has produced one; never run it against a hand-written result. UC-ISS-01 AC-5 waits on Sprint 03 and UC-ISS-05 AC-4 on Sprint 06. Sequence: next, after T16. Planner github-agentic-workflow-planner, implementer github-platform-implementer, reviewer github-agentic-workflow-reviewer.
